pages.title: Appaloosa
pages.text: Known for its leopard-spot pattern - the only breed whose coat always carries **dots**. Tough and athletic.

pages.title: Scout's Vision
pages.text:
After dark, the rider sees as the horse does: **Night Vision while mounted at night**, and through a thunderstorm dark enough to pass for it.

It comes on quietly - no swirling particles, no icon - and fades on its own once the sun is back up.
